say.speaker: chespin
say.text: The trail is clear. My thanks. I could keep them from passing, but I could never make them leave.

say.speaker: healer
say.text: Not a single scratch on that shell! Were you guarding this trail all by yourself?

say.speaker: chespin
say.text: I am training to become a knight of the Verdant Kingdom. {lord}, allow me to march with your company. I will be your shield.

say.speaker: lord
say.text: We'd be glad to have you, Chespin! Just try to keep up on the mountain.
